decisions.creation_safe_objects: building does not require primary entrance; building_primary_entrance assigns it after entrance exists. unit.parent_unit_id is nullable for root units.
decisions.field_mapping_policy: Every current field maps to an existing target field, a structured multi-target transformation, archive/compatibility disposition, RFI/exception, or accepted-loss request. This pack uses no accepted-loss requests.
decisions.geometry_subject_integrity: geometry_version subject_entity/subject_id is constrained by role-to-subject registry and validated by WO-002B triggers; role-to-type rules are explicit in target-model.json.
decisions.publication_snapshots: publication_release_item stores complete immutable projection payload JSON, payload hash, manifest URI, exact location_record_version_id, and exact public_code_alias_id.
decisions.root_admin_insertability: administrative_unit_version.parent_administrative_unit_id is nullable; root and first versions are insertable.
decisions.single_current_version_mechanism: Open recorded interval: recorded_to IS NULL is the only authoritative current-version marker. Pointers and booleans are derived views only and not stored in the target model.
